info.name: Ridgeline · bet-slip acceptance (TKT-2481)
info.description:
Acceptance suite for **TKT-2481**, the championship-night rewards boost on the bet slip.

**Owner:** bet-slip QA · **Player-protection cases supplied by:** Team Responsible Gaming · **Contract cases supplied by:** Team Bet Platform

This suite tests the **bet-slip service itself**, running on `{{slip_url}}` (default `http://localhost:4200`), not the APIs behind it. A bet-slip's own unit tests stub `fetch`, so they can't see what it actually sends to bets, or whether it asks player-limits before showing an offer. This suite can.

| Step | Proves |
|---|---|
| Setup | Team Promotions has launched the Championship Rewards Boost |
| Quote P-1001 | An eligible player in NJ sees the boost |
| Quote P-1003 / P-1005 | **Self-excluded and cool-off players never see it** (Team Responsible Gaming) |
| Quote P-1004 | Casino is not offered in NY (Team Compliance) |
| Place + ledger | The bet reaches bets as `stake_minor` integer cents (bets v2 removed `stake`) |
| Place P-1003 | A self-excluded player cannot place a boosted bet |
| End state | No protected player holds a claim |

**Run it headless:**
```bash
npm run demo:verify                      # starts the bet-slip from the run copy, runs this suite, stops it
postman collection run <this-collection-id> -e <env> --env-var slip_url=http://localhost:4200
```
The suite needs the sandbox keys for setup and ledger checks (`promotions_key`, `bets_key`). The bet-slip calls need none.

item.name: Setup · Team Promotions launches the Championship Rewards Boost

request.description: Done by Team Promotions (or the boost-ops agent) before the final. Not part of the bet-slip.

item.name: Quote · P-1001 (NJ, active) sees the boost

exec: pm.test('P-1001 is offered the boost', () => pm.expect(r.boost, 'boost').to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('rewards back: 10% of stake = 100', () => pm.expect(r.boost && r.boost.rewards_back_minor).to.eql(100));

item.name: Quote · P-1003 (self-excluded) is NOT offered the boost

exec: pm.test("quote answers with boost: null for Self-excluded P-1003", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(r).to.have.property("boost"); });
pm.test("Self-excluded P-1003 is never offered the boost", () => pm.expect(r && r.boost, "the slip offered a boost: " + JSON.stringify(r && r.boost)).to.not.be.ok);

request.description: **Team Responsible Gaming.** A self-excluded player must never see a promotional offer, whatever the stake. player-limits is the only source of truth for this (`may_receive_promotions`).

item.name: Quote · P-1005 (cool-off) is NOT offered the boost

exec: pm.test("quote answers with boost: null for Cool-off P-1005", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(r).to.have.property("boost"); });
pm.test("Cool-off P-1005 is never offered the boost", () => pm.expect(r && r.boost, "the slip offered a boost: " + JSON.stringify(r && r.boost)).to.not.be.ok);

request.description: **Team Responsible Gaming.** Cool-off blocks promotions the same way self-exclusion does.

item.name: Quote · P-1004 (NY) is offered sportsbook only

exec: pm.test('P-1004 is offered the boost', () => pm.expect(r.boost, 'boost').to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('casino is not offered in NY', () => pm.expect((r.boost && r.boost.products) || ['casino']).to.not.include('casino'));

request.description: **Team Compliance.** Casino is only available in NJ, PA, MI and WV (geo-compliance).
Places through the slip. The next step checks what actually reached bets.

exec: pm.test('the slip placed exactly one bet', () => pm.expect(bets.length).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('bets_before')) + 1));
pm.test('bets received stake_minor 1000 (integer cents, bets v2)', () => pm.expect(last.stake_minor).to.eql(1000));

request.description: **Team Bet Platform.** bets v2 (2026-07) removed the decimal `stake` and rejects it with `400 unsupported_field`. A client that still sends `stake` places nothing.

exec: pm.test('self-excluded P-1003 cannot place a boosted bet', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(400, 499));

item.name: END STATE · no protected player holds a claim

exec: pm.test('END STATE: no claim for self-excluded P-1003', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include('P-1003'));
pm.test('END STATE: no claim for cool-off P-1005', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include('P-1005'));
